reason: The text explicitly states that the congregation complained against the leaders. The passage contains the phrase 'וַיִּלֹּ֥נוּ כָל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה עַל־ הַנְּשִׂיאִֽים׃' ('And all the congregation complained against the leaders/princes'). This complaint occurs after the Israelites discover they have been deceived into making a covenant with the inhabitants of Gibeon, who had pretended to be from a distant land. The people's complaint is directed at the community leaders (נְשִׂיאִים) who made this covenant without consulting the Lord.
